Surrounded by Johnston and Wake County neighborhoods, this location is accessible and easy to travel to. Riccobene stands out with its peaceful atmosphere, where patients feel supported and leave motivated to take care of their oral health with ease and comfort.

We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are offered at the Clayton, NC office?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

How do I schedule a dental appointment in Clayton, NC?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Does the Clayton office provide Invisalign® treatment?

Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.

Is same-day emergency dental care available in Clayton, NC?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Clayton location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Can I get dental implants or a consultation at the Clayton office?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available.

Do you offer preventive dental care like cleanings and sealants in Clayton?

Absolutely. At our office, we recognize the importance of preventive dental care for your oral health and provide services such as professional cleanings and sealants.

Where is your Clayton dental office located, and what are the hours?

Our office Hours are Monday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Thursday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Riccobene Associates Family Dentistry is located on 31 Oleander Drive, Clayton, NC 27527. We look forward to seeing you!

Do you provide cosmetic services such as whitening, veneers, or Invisalign®?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Do you accept my insurance or offer membership/financing plans in Clayton, NC?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
